Game Overview

Zombie Conquer Countries puts players into a strategy experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Zombie Conquer Countries comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Zombie Conquer Countries?

Zombie Conquer Countries is a free strategy game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Zombie Conquer Countries free to play?

Yes, Zombie Conquer Countries is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
